protocol: RepoQA-derived Python function localization; exact indexed path/name/start-byte; not native RepoQA code-similarity or patch pass.

preprocessing.document: path + function name + first 1600 code characters; model max sequence applies
preprocessing.query: official needle description; model max sequence applies
preprocessing.tfidf: word unigram/bigram, sublinear tf; fit per repository
preprocessing.stamp: 256-bit four-view document; query observes semantic/task and explicitly quoted entity only

limitations: Candidate source and queries excluded from Git. Same-repository source is indexed; repository split separates tuning/evaluation, not indexed corpus. No reader, patch test, authorization treatment, cold model load, or end-to-end agent timing in this study.
